name: Raising and Accelerating MSME Performance (RAMP) Interventions: Reimbursement of Energy and Water Audit Fees- DNH&DD
state: Dadra & Nagar Haveli And Daman & Diu
benefit:
This intervention promotes resource efficiency and sustainability among MSMEs by encouraging the adoption of energy and water-saving measures through professional audits. The intervention provides financial assistance to cover part of the audit cost.
> **Quantum of Assistance Energy or Water Audit Fees:**

- Cost of conducting Energy or Water Audits by recognised institutions or accredited auditin

all.value: Dadra & Nagar Haveli And Daman & Diu

_eligibility_text: 1. The unit must be Udyam registered with operations in the UT of DNH&DD. 1. Eligibility of MSME units in the Manufacturing or Service sector, upon commencement of commercial production or service operations, shall be governed by the duration of operation criteria as outlined in the relevant intervention of the scheme. 1. Eligibility of the MSME unit shall be subject to the detailed conditions specified under the respective scheme provisions.
